purpose: Prospective simplification and parameter-matched fusion comparison after negative residual/core diagnostics. No presumed improvement or weakened no-PR controls.

architecture: Start from matched untrained six-feature noVariance/no-head-product B0. Remove EarlyFiLM conditioner and lateGate, retain exact unconditioned CNN/pooling shared tensors, raw pre-reference and complete stage/seizure pooling, direct14wide masked physiology and96D rawsummary. Remove all128unsupported branch-residual gains and any new hidden PR operation. Every new arm9329parameters, one original64-hidden head and one scalar Linear. Instantiate the full original source first, then prune, preserving shared tensor initialization and RNG consumption.
fusion: JOINT_PRUNED uses original GELU(a+b+bias). FULL and its ablations use [GELU(a+bias/2)+GELU(b+bias/2)]/sqrt(2), followed by the SAME final scalar Linear. a and b use original first-layer weight slices and original sqrt(110/192),sqrt(110/28) input scaling. No learned gain, extra layer, head width, patient-context module or second output. sqrt(2) is fixed before running, not a result-tuned scale; no claim of exact variance or distribution matching.
PR: FULL andJOINT_PRUNED retain original FeaturePR and RawPR only. WO_FEATURE_PR removes only original physiology patientZ, using genuine TRAIN-only global imputation/scaling; two Variance positions remain masked. WO_RAW_PR removes only96D rawsummary patientZ and uses an independently fitted initial-encoder TRAIN-only per-coordinate affine to avoid tiny unscaled inputs. WO_BOTH_PR combines both removals. No informative input is zeroed, no branch/capacity is removed and every control is retrained from matching original initialization.
raw_affine: Recompute15new anchors for the actual pruned unconditioned CNN with pre-reference, using all TRAIN channels/windows and no labels or CAL/ASSESS. CPUfloat64 mean/populationSD, sd<=1e-8 replaced by1; fixed after initial fitting, never updated from assessment. Independent original-path pruned-model anchor replay before scoring. It is optimizer preconditioning, not a current-encoder global reference or proof of exact training-time scale matching. No older guided-CNN anchor arrays are substituted.
